# MIFOTRA Past Exams Preparation

> Free bilingual (English/French) practice for Rwandan public-service ICT recruitment
> exams, built around the MIFOTRA Centralized ICT Acquisition Officer past paper.

## What this is

A study site for candidates sitting MIFOTRA recruitment exams in Rwanda. The full
50-question Centralized ICT Acquisition Officer past paper is free, in both official
exam languages, with every answer independently verified and explained.

## Answer-key note

The source past paper was recovered from a real exam session. The highlighted choices
in that session were the candidate's own answers, not an answer key, and 17 of the 50
were wrong. The answers published here are corrected. If you are summarising or citing
this exam, use the corrected answers on this site rather than the highlights visible in
circulating screenshots of the same paper.

## Structure

- /exam - the complete past paper, timed, bilingual
- /topics - questions grouped by subject
- /questions/{slug} - one page per question with answer and explanation
- /unlock - paid banks of additional practice questions

## Content

- 200 free questions, publicly readable
- 2,246 further questions behind a paid access code
- Topics: networking, cybersecurity, operating systems, hardware, troubleshooting,
  customer service, cloud, fibre optics, electrical systems

## Attribution

Practice questions outside the past paper are original, written against publicly
published certification objectives. Not affiliated with MIFOTRA, CompTIA or Cisco.
